_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Name pools for Vharlen, the Burning Isle — the Vharl, island folk who live on a volcano. Their style is NOT Torbor's rustic English: short given names with doubled consonants and open -a/-u endings (Tavi, Kesk, Oskel), and a HEARTH name for a family — the house a person was born under, two hard syllables (Keshvar, Ormakku, Thallu). Titles are trades of the island (net-mender, steam-wife, rim-keeper). Read by the server's NPC namer (js/sim/npc-names.js), tools/content-offices.mjs and the quest writers. Original; checked by tests/C/vharlen-content.test.js against the banned list.
style: Given name + hearth name: 'Tavi Keshvar', 'Oskel Thallu'. Old folk drop the hearth and take a title: 'Steam-wife Ninu', 'Old Varr'. Raiders of the Slagborn give themselves one hard name and an ash-word: 'Skarra Ashkeel', 'Thrane Cinderhand'.

slagborn._doc: The raiders name themselves: one hard name + an ash-word (for elites, rares and event bosses of the Slagborn).
